questions.stem_text:
The ________ School of jurisprudence believes that the law is an aggregate of social
traditions and customs that have developed over the centuries.

Point out the most accurate response : According to Austin, law has the following
attributes :

options.D: Command, sovereign and obedience by subject

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Command, sovereign and sanction

questions.stem_text:
Which statement is closest to characterizing the principal difference between the
positions adopted by Hobbes and Locke?

options.A: They adopt different attitudes towards the role of the courts in maintaining order.
options.B: They disagree about the role of law in society.
options.C: They have opposing views about the nature of contractual obligations.
options.D: They differ in respect of their account of life before the social contract.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - They differ in respect of their account of life before the social contract.

questions.stem_text:
In Justice for Hedgehogs Dworkin endorses 'Hume's principle'. What does he understand by
this idea?

options.A: That there is no distinction between law and morality.
options.B: That there is a distinction between right and wrong.
options.C: That facts about the world or human nature cannot normally ordain what ought to be
options.D: That human rights are fundamentally unsound.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - That facts about the world or human nature cannot normally ordain what ought to be
